open_points.text: - probe_backup_location: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer a ProbePassed when the probe file was created and removed, and otherwise a StartDiagnostic whose diagnostic names the backup_dir item by the name of the backup_dir field of = models.RuntimeSettings, as every start diagnostic names an item, and what failed, the location missing or not a directory or the file not created or not removed, never the location's path; a probe file it could not remove MUST be left where it is, for the next run's removal of temporary files.
